name: Ottoman Empire
facts: Turkey and much of the Balkans, Middle East and North Africa

flag.description: A red field with a white crescent, opening towards the fly, and a white five-pointed star just beyond it.
flag.symbolism: The crescent and star became emblems of the Ottoman state in the late 18th century and are widely associated with the Islamic world.

hook: The Ottoman flag is the direct parent of Turkey's and practically the same white crescent and star on red; Tunisia sets its red crescent inside a white disc instead.
trivia: The flag was adopted in 1844, during the Tanzimat reforms that modernised the Ottoman state.
The Republic of Turkey kept the flag and fixed its exact proportions in the Turkish Flag Law of 1936.
